# October 7 (part 2): Building PCB schematic in KiCad!

I actually had a lot of fun following the guide to build the schematic. Here is my progress as of right now.
![Screenshot 2026-10-07 at 7.36.53 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/oROPu3MIbOQRawnBvX8oVwkwrYWfjhJD/944c8e921f378f39dd4f9127cdad3e581909c6b4cb4a961c2fe1f39367304106.png)

One of the reasons why it took so long is mainly because I'm new to the platform.

---

I had a lot of trouble...
1. Figuring out the controls (what does what and how to do stuff like switch modes and add stuff)
2. keybinds? I kind of struggled because I was trying to use keybinds that I'm used to using on other platforms like pressing `Control + A` instead of Just `A`, which created a few problems
3. Labels (or nets, whatever they are called)
4. Wiring: I don't really know why but wiring is really weird for me. I think the app has a really weird sort of functionality with how you can really do stuff and it's going to take me some time to get used to that

# October 8: Switched to PCB Editor and built the star

Here is my final product for today (I got kind of lazy with the star I don't want to the corner things)

![Screenshot 2026-10-08 at 5.49.39 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/oROPu3MIbOQRawnBvX8oVwkwrYWfjhJD/335f5175bd2f2342f93e4db06b0a29edb0976621fa61921849efc7501b1efb4a.png)

Today took a really long time and it was actually a really hard process.
## Mainly because this is my first time on the platform, I faced lots of struggles

For some reason Google wasn't helping so it took me so long to figure out where the PCB Editor is. Also, the instructions are like extremely vague and general and they did not help me at all unfortunately.

It kept saying that Youtube is my friend but for a beginner who has no idea what they are doing, I want something more personal to help like a guide for the exact project not a random Youtube video.

Anyway it took so long because this whole footprint thing and was really difficult for me.

![Screenshot 2026-10-08 at 5.52.41 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/oROPu3MIbOQRawnBvX8oVwkwrYWfjhJD/9f83a0fee909fee4376cfcbe76b88194eee1ae00866fb3cf1419f853c649ed02.png)

The guide **never** said what to do with the care packadge so it took so much work and effort to realize I have to import that `.pretty` folder and that was super annoying. Regardless though, I did it so it's fine.

![Screenshot 2026-10-08 at 5.53.39 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/oROPu3MIbOQRawnBvX8oVwkwrYWfjhJD/5c0b63f63a5bb23a65c8998621a879490790d619cef4b06e5737693f83caefbc.png)
